```python
import logging
from DD4hepSimulation import kernel, setupDetectors, setupPhysics, setupTrackingField, setupGun, setupUserParticleHandler, setupEDM4hepOutput
from DD4hepSimulation import import_geometry, importConstants, Geant4, EventAction, TrackingAction, SteppingAction, RunAction, StackingAction
from DD4hepSimulation import Logger

def run_dd4hep_simulation():
    # Set up logging
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
    logger = Logger()
    logger.outputLevel = logging.INFO

    # Import additional modules
    import DD4hepSimulation
    from DD4hepSimulation import setupDetectors, setupPhysics, setupTrackingField, setupGun, setupUserParticleHandler, setupEDM4hepOutput
    from DD4hepSimulation import import_geometry, importConstants, Geant4, EventAction, TrackingAction, SteppingAction, RunAction, StackingAction

    # Set up the kernel
    sim_kernel = kernel()
    sim_kernel.outputLevel = logging.INFO

    # Load geometry from file
    geometry_file = "detector.xml"
    geometry = import_geometry(geometry_file)
    sim_kernel.geometry = geometry

    # Import constants
    importConstants("constants.xml")

    # Configure Geant4 interface
    geant4 = Geant4()
    sim_kernel.addUserInitialization(geant4)

    # Set up the tracking field
    setupTrackingField(sim_kernel, fieldType="Uniform", fieldValue=[0, 0, 2.0])

    # Set up event actions
    sim_kernel.addInit(EventAction())
    sim_kernel.addInit(TrackingAction())
    sim_kernel.addInit(SteppingAction())
    sim_kernel.addInit(RunAction())
    sim_kernel.addInit(StackingAction())

    # Set up the particle gun
    setupGun(sim_kernel, particle="e-", energy=10.0, direction=[0,0,1])

    # Handle simulation particles
    setupUserParticleHandler(sim_kernel)

    # Build the physics list
    setupPhysics(sim_kernel, physicsList="FTFP_BERT")

    # Set up output (optional, e.g., EDM4hep)
    setupEDM4hepOutput(sim_kernel, filename="output.edm4hep.root")

    # Start the engine
    sim_kernel.run()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_dd4hep_simulation()
```
